payload.title: wake install: reach every session on this machine

payload.text: Shells out to the claude CLI rather than editing ~/.claude.json directly: that file is Claude Code live state, a running session may write it at any moment, and a lost update there costs more than this command is worth. add-json has no --force, so registration is remove-then-add or a rerun after the deployment moves would silently keep the stale URL.

payload.reason: Shipped with 9 tests. The exec hook is injected because an early test shelled out for real and registered a fake server in this machine's own Claude config.
